items.exampleEn: This is the best cake in town.

items.sentenceEn: The weather is bad today, so let's stay home.

items.sentenceZh: 我的兄弟有一隻小白貓。

items.sentenceEn: It is a very important test.
items.sentenceZh: 這是一個非常重要的考試。

items.stemEn: This is not a toy. It is a ____ car.
items.stemZh: 這不是玩具，這是一台真的車。

items.stemEn: We waited in a long ____ for the bus.
items.stemZh: 我們排了很長的隊等公車。

items.passageEn: My best friend, Kate, has long black hair. She works at a small cafe. The coffee there is very good, so there is always a long line in the morning. Kate says her job is not easy, but it is important to her.
items.passageZh: 我最好的朋友 Kate 有一頭黑色長髮。她在一家小咖啡店工作。那裡的咖啡很好喝，所以早上總是大排長龍。Kate 說她的工作不輕鬆，但對她來說很重要。

questions.questionZh: Kate 的頭髮是什麼樣子？
為什麼早上總是大排長龍？

rubricZh: best 前面加 the 或所有格（例如 the best job、my best friend）
